articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu says Iran will never have nuclear weapons 'with or without a deal'
articles.summary: Prime Minister Netanyahu stated at an IDF pilot course graduation ceremony that Iran will not acquire nuclear weapons, emphasizing Israel's successful operations against Iran over the past year.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates concerns about US-Turkey F-35 sale
articles.summary: Netanyahu told CNN that the proposed US sale of F-35 fighter jets to Turkey could disrupt the Middle East balance of power and expressed concerns about Turkey's relations with Hamas and the Muslim Brotherhood.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu warns Donald Trump against sale of F-35s to Turkey
articles.summary: Netanyahu warned in a Fox and Friends interview that giving F-35 fighter jets to Turkey could upset the Middle East balance of power and threaten Israeli air superiority in the region.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: 'My relationship with President Donald Trump is excellent'
articles.summary: Netanyahu told Fox News that the US and Israel are strong allies and that he has an excellent relationship with President Trump, agreeing with him on major issues including Iran policy.

articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu is campaigning to build a broader coalition government by ending the political boycott against him, arguing that Israel faces external threats requiring consensus-based governance ahead of October elections.
